avis.texte: I've been using for it for along time and it seems working on me with no complaints, I use it before going to bed at night….
I've used this cream on my face after every shave for about 25 years. I'm 71 now with virtually no wrinkles — especially none around my eyes!

I'm 81 yrs old and have been using StriVectin for about 20 yrs. No one believes my age and ask if I've had work done. I tell them I haven't. Your product has given me very beautiful skin and I love the results. Thank you for your fantastic products.
I use this product twice a day every day and have been for the last 15 years. I receive a lot of favorable remarks about my skin and I'm 75 years old.
I've been using StriVectin SD Advanced for 22 years. I always get compliments on my skin. My dermatologist even asked what I use on my face. I would never use anything else. I'm a StriVectin lifer.

avis.titre: Good product but not liking scent
avis.texte: My only complaint is the smell. I swear it smells lightly like an ashtray. I wondered if whoever filled container was a smoker. Sadly, I have a fabulous nose. I prefer the Strivectin crepe control tightening body cream. It smells great. I am wondering how much stride Vein is actually in each of those products. ???
I have used the advance plus intensive moisturizer for many years. As a result, I have absolutely no wrinkles. In addition to this, I also use a strive cream cleanser.
It keeps my skin looking beautiful, and a lot younger than it actually is.

There are certain skincare products that make you realize some companies actually know what they are doing; and this moisturizer is one of them. I have been smoking for thirty years and I drink about two pots of coffee every day (I know, bad habits), but this moisturizer makes me look at least 10 years younger than my 51 years. It erases all of the ravines and chasms in my skin, along with the parentheses around my mouth and also most of my crow's feet (clearly, I don't follow rules well). Its texture is smooth and a small amount covers my entire face and neck, so this large size will last me until Black Friday at least. And it has so many amazing ingredients that I don't have to bother looking for any other skincare; so I consider it an investment, not a splurge. It is worth every penny. I imagine it works miracles on normal people's skin. I am a lifelong believer in this moisturizer.
HAVE BEEN USING STRIVECTION FOR OVER 30+ YEARS AND FOLKS STILL TELL ME THAT I LOOK 20 YEARS YOUNGER. THIS IS A TERRIFIC MOISTURIZER!!
I have been using this product for over a year pretty consistently. It seems to help with my aging skin lines.

avis.titre: Missing 1/2 of my order. Only 1 star
avis.texte: I am missing 1 of 2 expensive items from my order. Please re send the 2 nd item retinol intensive cream I was charged for item not received.

I discover StriVectin in a magazine article I read in the waiting room at the hospital. the article said StriVectin was the secret weapon the stars used to keep their youthful appearance. That was over 20 years ago and it did everything it said it would. I am currently 80 years old and can pass for someone younger than I am. It has been a blessing.
Best wrinkle cream in the world in my opinion just started using it and I already see results im 38 now and look better then when I was 35. . . less noticeable wrinkles thats for sure. . .
Strivectin makes my face feel amazing. After 6 weeks I can already see a difference in texture and fine lines. Best facial cream I have ever used
Love Strivectin. I have used it for many years and get compliments all the time about my skin.

First time ordering this product after reading the reviews but as I write this review I have not yet received SD Advanced Plus Intensive Moisturizer. I cannot give five stars, therefore that is why I give one star.
The best product you had you changed and now I can't find anything else that comes close. The original tighten and lift peptight was the best you had. The new one isn't good.

I have been using triacin moisturizer for years and years. My skin is dryer now as I age, I love it and wouldn't use anything else I have also recently tried the peptide and I'm very very happy with it as well
This is my #1 face cream for daytime and I am very pleased with the results. I also enjoy the right amount of moisture it leaves behind. I use this daily.

This has been a game changer for me, I use it along with the peptide plus (first the peptide plus & then layering the SD advanced Plus. It's keeping a lot of wrinkles at by even though I'm definitely in an age group that can't escape them.

I have used this product since it first became available. I am 86 now and love it. My face and neck are wrinkle free and firm and have an even tone. I love this cream and will always use it. I don't need anything else except the eye cream that you sell.
Have used for several years and am happy with results of keeping fine wrinkles under control as a senior citizen

I really wanted to like the StriVectin SD Advanced PLUS Intensive Moisturizer, especially with all the claims about "collagen-boosting peptides" and "Alpha-3 technology. " Unfortunately, after consistent use, this was a total letdown and a complete waste of money. The main issues: No Effect on Wrinkles: Despite the marketing promising visible results in a week, my fine lines and deeper wrinkles haven't changed at all. It feels like a standard, overpriced lotion rather than an "intensive concentrate. " Zero Smoothing: It didn't even improve my skin texture. My face doesn't feel smoother or more refined; if anything, the thick consistency just sits on top of the skin without truly absorbing. Overpriced: For the high price tag, you expect more than just basic hydration. You can get the same moisturizing effect from a drugstore brand for a fraction of the cost.
I have used this product for over 25 years and now 73, and people continue to tell me how young I look!

I tried a Strivectin Peptide serum, and it was great, so I read reviews about the entire line. This moisturizer was touted as one of the best, and I gave it a try (thank you, Ulta, for your fabulous "beauty steals"). It's an easily absorbed "gel-cream" formula that packs a punch with three different peptides that boost collagen and elastin levels. As well, hyaluronic acid provides deep hydration. After a couple of weeks, I see noticeable improvements with fine lines and wrinkles. Bonus: a little goes a long way!
I did not find this product to be hydrating enough for mature skin.

avis.titre: Not a five star only because of the scent
avis.texte: I do like the smooth application of this lotion and it does seem to be having a positive effect on my skin. The only thing that I do not like at all is the scent which is very chemical forward. Otherwise it seems fine nothing greater than anything else that I've been using, and I don't know that it would buy it again due to the scent.
I've been using products since I received them and I see no change.
I have tried more expensive creams but this is the BEST moisturizer with the MOST improvements to my skins fine lines and wrinkles!
I've been using this product for the last 20 years and I love it. I'm glad I stumbled upon it because it is a great product.

I started using Strivectin around 2003; when that was their only product. I've been using it for a long time and I get a nice comment about my skin frequently. It's a great product! They used to advertise it as "Better Than Botox"
This is my go to moisturizer every morning and night. I've been using this moisturizer for years.

I love this product. I've been using Strivectin for almost 30 years. I look a lot younger than my age, no wrinkles, just some sagging in the jowls. I tell everyone who asks me what I do to look so young. , that I use Strivectin.
This moisturizer goes on without feeling greasy. I'm able to use it with my makeup and other products.
This product is perfect for wrinkles and keeping your skin moisturized. At 67 yrs old my skin looks and feels better than it has in a long time.
Strivectin is my favorite cream and has been for 15+ years. It is just wonderful and will ALWAYS be part of my ritual!!

I have been using it on my face for small fine lines started as I age. I have only been using it once a day for about a month, but I can see a difference around my nose/mouth. This small size has been lasting a while as you only need a small amount. I would repurchase.

I'm always nervous about moisturizers since I have sensitive skin and I'm extra sensitive to scents because of my asthma. However. this felt great on my skin and was absorbs quickly. I feel like it really moisturized my skin. It's a great product.

Looking for an anti-aging cream with wrinkle-fighting power? One that hydrates like crazy? But isn't thick and creamy and doesn't make you break out? Well, I'm obsessed with this one by StriVectin! It can be used day or night! @influenster @strivectin #complimentary #matureakinxare #antiwrinklefacecream #antiwrinjlebodycream #selfcaresunday

avis.titre: Will continue to use this moisturizer.
avis.texte: Absolutely loved this product. It is creamy and gentle. It is not greasy and it smells amazing. I have very sensitive skin and it is not irritating at all. I have noticed improved smoothness and significantly less irritation now that I'm using it. It absorbs quickly and my makeup goes on well over it.

I've been using this cream for a few weeks and honestly love how rich but lightweight it feels. My skin looks smoother and more hydrated, and some fine lines around my mouth and forehead look softer. It's packed with peptides and niacin (NIA-114) that help boost collagen, so it's great for anti-aging and even stretch marks.
This product is so small for me to enjoy it. It feel moisturizing enough but needs wnought time to use and see results. I used it on my stretchmarks but needs more time to see improvements.

I received StriVectin Advanced Plus Intensive Moisturizer in exchange for a review. This is a nice creamy moisturizer that includes collagen, other peptides and hyaluronic acid to help make skin nourished and healthy. The moisturizer goes on smoothly and didn't leave my skin overly greasy. I found the scent to be very mild. I used this product for several weeks and did notice my skin was smoother and overall looked younger. My skin is noticeably dry and it looks much more hydrated. That being said, this product is on the top end of the price range for moisturizer in my opinion. So it might not be an option for everyone.

I waited more than 6 weeks to review, to make sure I give the best review I can give. I've been using the moisturizer on my forehead, I guess I'm very expressive. I'd helped minimize the deep lines I have on my forehead. The packaging is perfect for traveling. The scent is decent.

avis.titre: Results showing in as little as 3 weeks!
avis.texte: This product works great on hydrating the skin and smoothing lines, especially on the neck! After only 3 weeks of daily use, I would tell a HUGE difference in the texture of my skin. While it's not specifically a neck cream, it works excellent for us 30s ladies who are starting to get some lines and dry crepey skin! It smells a little funky at first but you get used to it.

after 2 months of using StriVectin, I love the results as a deep hand moisturizer! With a neutral ish" scent it's great to use overnight and waking up with soft, renewed skin. Definitely a great moisturizer, wrinkle cream, and dead skin remover!

I received this product, free and complementary from Influenster and StriVectin in exchange for my honest opinion. Overall, this is a fabulous skin cream. It is super hydrating all day long. The plumping ingredients made my face look more youthful, and smooth. Everything, even fine lines and wrinkles were smoothed out! I would definitely purchase this. Thank you for the opportunity!

avis.titre: Greasy, overly scented, and no noticeable change
avis.texte: Unfortunately I didn't notice any change while using this on my face, or on stretch marks in an area I couldn't photograph. The menthol scent was overwhelming and all I could smell all day, and it felt very greasy. It went on evenly, and the little bottle was cute and easy to use without it spitting out far too much. I won't be continuing to use this.
I really wanted to love this product, I have wrinkles and fine lines that I want to be able to take care of. However after one use, my face broke out incredibly. I had such high hope for this!

I was more impressed by this product than I expected to be! It definitely plumps my skin BEAUTIFULLY. It tested it out for a month, twice a day before settling on an opinion. And I'll definitely keep using it. I've seen a decrease it the viability of the fine lines on my forehead. I'll be tested it out in stretch marks next. This isn't greasy but it's super moisturizing. I've easily worn it under my makeup with no issues, or just with no makeup for a glass-skin fresh look. I'd definitely repurchase once I run out!
Love how this feels. It's not thin or thick, perfectly made. Light scent that doesn't bother my sensitive skin. Shape and the size of the bottle make it easy to handle.

Overall, I have to say I like this moisturizer. It's soaked into the skin nicely and does not leave greasy finish. The anti-aging properties are definitely noticeable. It did not do anything to my fine lines. However, my pores are definitely looking a little bit tighter.

This Strivectin moisturizer is pretty good. Id say it leans more toward dry skin for sure. I have oily skin but it sank in pretty well. You barely need any. It smells like very subtle min. It has cute but basic packaging. The ingredients are fantastic for hydration.
I received this complimentary from Influenster and StriVectin in exchange for my honest review. I love this anti-wrinkle formula. 10 outta 10. Definitely would recommend.

avis.titre: I believe this will be a regular for me!
avis.texte: I am a longtime fan of all things Strivectin! I have used several of their products, including the antiaging line for neck and under eye. I've always been impressed by the quality of their product, especially for the cost. This is a great value and I have always bought it willingly each time. I was excited to get a chance to try the Advanced Plus product, because as I get older, my skin seems to just be more and more parched, and the fine lines and wrinkles are winning! I've been using this product for a couple of weeks, but my photos are same day, because I wanted to show how much different even after one application that I feel my skin looks. This product is thick and emollient, but not heavy or greasy. It has no noticeable fragrance, but for maybe a slightly minty smell. I feel it makes my fine lines immediately less noticeable and makes my skin look fresher and not as sallow. I'm really looking forward to a couple more weeks of use, as I feel like it's just going to continue to improve the quality of my skin as I go. I know that when I finish this product, I will definitely purchase more.

I've been using StriVectin's SD Advanced PLUS Intensive Moisturizer daily for about a month now, and it's made a noticeable difference in my skin's texture and hydration. The cream is rich but absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling supple without any greasy residue. I especially love how it brightens overall my skin looks more even-toned and radiates a healthy glow. A little goes a long way, so even though it's a premium product, the jar lasts a good while, making it feel like a solid value. The subtle, clean scent also adds a touch of luxury without being overwhelming. Overall, I'd say this moisturizer delivers its deeply hydrating, subtly luminous, and well worth adding to your skincare routine.

The Strivectin SD advanced plus intensive moisturizer is wonderful! It provides a ton of moisture without being heavy. It melts in the skin as you apply it and I really love how soft it feels. I didn't pickup any particular scent. I do recommend it.
I love everything about this moisturizer. It's thick and creamy without being heavy or greasy. Very light scent. I think it helped reduce the appearance of lines some keep my skin hydrated and fresh.

I had been searching for a cream that truly works on wrinkles, and then Influenster sent me StriVectin SD Advanced™ Plus to try for free. Honestly, I wasn't expecting quick results, but after just a few weeks I noticed my skin became smoother and more hydrated. Fine lines around my eyes look less visible, and my face looks fresher. I love that the cream is non-greasy, absorbs quickly, and feels comfortable on the skin. The downside is the price 😅, but the effect is definitely worth it. Overall, this is one of the few creams where I can really see a difference. I recommend it!
I don't feel like I tried this long enough to see if it was effective. The scent was pleasant which I appreciated. I do feel like it could absorb better and was greasy on my face.

StriVectin SD Advance PLUS Intensive Moisturizer is one product I didn't even know I needed. It is so good to my skin and doesn't cause breakouts. It contains collagen with boosting peptides power, Elastin, Hyaluronic Acid helping skin look visibly plump, less visible lines, wrinkles and even helps on stretch marks. No wonder it is the number one selling stretch mark cream.

I'm a big fan of this awesome moisturizer! I've only used it for a few weeks but have already seen subtle results. The texture of my skin feels smoother and I've already seen some smoothing of fine wrinkles/lines. The scent is very light. I'll definitely continue using it and I'd absolutely recommend it to others.
Good product, it works for certain, but you must be consistent in your use for it to make a difference. It is worth trying it out. The texture is nice and not strong scented.

I love this moisturizer. I'm pregnant right now so I didn't see a big change. So I can't wait one more month until my due day so I'll see more results. . But what I can say that it's First off, this lotion is super moisturizing and absorbs well into the skin. It's just a fantastic addition to my skin care routine, it has really helped improve my skin texture. I appreciate a rich formula that's non-greasy, fast-absorbing, and gentle on skin. I notice visible improvements, fine wrinkles or stretch marks may require longer consistent use to see subtle changes. Recommend. Will by again.

Beautiful products leave the skin feeling plump and hydrated. Gets rid of wrinkles and stretch marks leaving the skin beautiful. Easy to use with a squeeze bottle and no scent with a good amount of product for your money. Packaging is basic.

avis.titre: A rich yet lightweight moisturizer that hydrates,
avis.texte: I've been using the StriVectin SD Advanced PLUS Intensive Moisturizer and I'm impressed with how nourishing yet lightweight it feels. The texture is silky and absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy residue. My skin feels plump, hydrated, and smooth, and I've noticed an improvement in fine lines over time. The packaging is sleek and hygienic, and the subtle scent is pleasant but not overpowering. Perfect for both day and night use! This moisturizer truly delivers on effectiveness.
This is a very smooth thin lotion has a light minty fresh scent to it . Made my face seem a little smoother and more even . It absorbs quickly and isn't greasy .
This is a great moisturizer. I appreciate the nice texture and how it absorbs well, without leaving my skin feeling super oily. It works really well!
I really wanted to love this product and it wasn't bad, it just didn't do much for my wrinkles or stretch marks. I used it consistently and it was a great moisturizer but with minimal effect.

I have extremely dry skin. Not just having a "tight feeling" on my face- my skin is so dry that it cracks and many moisturizers will just pill up instead of absorbing into my skin. This one absorbs and staves off the tight feeling for the entire day. A little goes a long way too; I've been using it for a month and haven't even used half of the product yet. Once I apply it the lines on my face smooth out and it looks firmer.

It is a very good product. I utilized the entire time allowed to review because with having mature skin, I feel it's important to take the necessary time to give that review especially if the product is about wrinkles. Lol. I must give it to them, it does work. I did do a test on my arm first when I received it just to make sure there was no reaction and there was not. Then it was off for the test and it's great. It's very moisturizing as well and I was starting to see some crows feet but they have diminished. I am a believer. I don't have stretch marks but this product says it works on that as well so I think it is worth giving it a shot for that if you have some. It doesn't have an overwhelming scent (really none at all), it's packaged well, safety tab on the top so you know it hasn't been messed with at all. I definitely recommend this product. Thank you so much, Influenster and Strivectin for the opportunity! @influenster @strivectin #complimentary

I can see why this product is called Intensive! Very thick but very pleasant. I didn't try it anywhere on my body just my face. Since it is heavily moisturizing you can definitely expect less visible fine lines in matter of days. It also gives you a very smooth feeling. I do love how the moisturizer is almost matte at the beginning but unfortunately throughout the day it gets a little heavier causing my skin to be oilier. And for that reason I can see myself using it only as a night cream. But very good one!

avis.titre: Works well, got some acne though
avis.texte: I have used this brand before and enjoyed- this product is such a nice size you don't mind using it twice a day. I cut this close to the date to use a full 30 days. I noticed softening of my forehead lines but also increased acne. I don't mind having that to get some softer wrinkles but can't use this as a staple more a treatment. I'd like to try once every other day and see if it still helps me without breaking me out. I started this on my neck and do see improvement as well. I would love an acne sensitive StriVectin line! The packaging and quality is always top notch and like I said this has a great size for your stretch marks or face will go a long way.

I have never experienced a moisturizer quite like this before. It really changed my skin so much. I have always struggled with dry skin, but also skin the breaks out really easily. It's really hard to find a moisturizer that doesn't cause acne. This does just that. I also noticed that my skin had a great glow. It was so hydrated and radiant. It's the perfect base for flawless makeup.

I love StriVectin. Their products do what they say and are the OG of peptides. They are an excellent value. The cream is elegant and has no scent, which I could detect. It does take time to see results so give it a few months.

A wrinkle smoothing moisturizer with Alpha-3 Peptide that targets skin's natural collagen for visible results in just 4 weeks. It also contains Copper Tripeptide that targets 10 types of collagen to reduce the look of stretch marks. I've been testing the wrinkle reduction capabilities of this cream, but not the effect on stretch marks (that is next for sure!) It moisturizes deeply and makes skin feel soft, smooth and supple. I only used it at night, as it is quite rich and would not do well with the humidity in my area. The only thing I don't like about this cream is the slight minty fragrance. Even when avoiding the eye area, I still experienced some irritation in my eyes.
This product really has helped moisturize my skin and reduce the appearance of fine lines. I have enjoyed using it the past month. I will buy it and recommend it!

I had high hopes for this product, considering that it is supposed to have 30% more collagen- boosting peptide power! And claims that it's so powerful, it even works on stretch marks. I would say that when I apply it on my skin I do feel that my skin is very hydrated and plump, but I have not noticed any improvement in the small wrinkles that I have. I have also been applying it to my skin stretch marks that I have from pregnancy to see if it would actually help. Similar results, my skin feels more hydrated and the look of my stretch marks appear to look like they are dimenishing, however I don't think its actually doing much except creating an illusion. I'll continue to use It to see if it helps after couple months, but not a product that I will keep reaching for.

I am trying this moisturizer first time. This cream comes in a tube package . It is creamy , rich yet light weight . It is non greasy to feel oily. It absorbs quickly and skin looks smooth and nourished. It helps to improve fine lines . I like how my skin looks after use. I have not noticed any noticeable difference yet . I will keep using it to see how it helps fade fines . It is on a pricy side not sure if I will buy this untill I see some real results.
Love this moisturizer is so hydrating and quick absorption doesn't make you feel greasy. I've seen a visible difference after using this so definitely this is gonna be a great winter moisturizer.

avis.titre: Not sure why it made itch
avis.texte: This product is ok but it made my forehead itch. It had good texture and absorption. No scent. I think it's ok it just made me itch. Not sure why because I'm not allergic to any of those ingredients.

This seemed to work well as a moisturizer and was very hydrating. I tried this product on my stretch marks on my abdomen. While I saw a very slight diminishing effect of the stretch marks, it was not enough improvement to justify the cost of this moisturizer.

I received this product from influenster in exchange for my honest review. StriVectin anti wrinkle & stretch mark has a light scent to it. It does have a thick consistency, but it is non greasy or oily on the skin absorbs right in. I think this product is great and look forward to using it more in the future.

I did not like the texture, and I feel like it do not work for me very well. Now it could be from weight loss, and the fact of having deep scaring do it not to work. But I didn't like the texture, or scent!
Obsessed - made my skin so soft and beautiful. It definitely helped with reducing wrinkles too. I was so impressed with this product, I'm excited to try it on my stretch marks next.
Very lightweight, easy to apply moisturizer. Definitely leaves my skin feeling plump and hydrated. I like that it's a rich formula but not heavy feeling on my skin.

I got this anti-wrinkle treatment for free for my honest review.I've been using it twice a day for over a month now, and while it moisturizes my very dry skin well, there's no noticeable difference between fine lines and the overall skin texture it advertises. I won't buy it again, as unfortunately I don't think it's worth it.

Is this diminishing my neck wrinkle? Maybe? With hormonal changes and weight fluctuations, it's hard to tell without using it for several months. But I can say it is a great moisturizer and doesn't irritate my skin. I appreciate that it doesn't have a strong smell and the texture is perfect for this in between season where it's cooler on some days and sweaty on others

avis.titre: Great peptide cream for wrinkles and stretch marks
avis.texte: I've been using this product for a few weeks now and I'm already seeing results. My wrinkles are less visible and my skin looks more youthful. It's also has improved the look of my stretch marks. The scent is wonderful! It's a clean, fresh scent. There's no greasiness after using just soft, smooth skin. It contains so many good ingredients including several different types of peptides. The only thing I will say is keep it away from your eyes. I made this mistake and ignored the packaging. It made my under eyes burn slightly. Other than that, I'm enjoying using this product.

I have loved the results I have seen from this moisturizer. It has kept my skin calm thanks to the hyaluronic acid keeping it moisturized and collagen and elastin keeping it plump helping to reduce the fine lines. The results are amazing!

avis.titre: StrVectin is worth it - next level hydration!
avis.texte: I've been testing this peptide-packed cream for a few weeks and honestly... it's so GOOD. My skin feels smoother, wrinkles are softening, and the hydration…Next level! 🙌 My photos are the before and after, plus a tan:)

This product has made a significant improvement in my fine lines and wrinkles. It is super hydrating and gentle on my sensitive skin. I love how well it blends and sinks into my skin, leaving it moisturized, smooth, and glowing. It is truly a must-have for anyone with aging skin or stretch marks, as it can be used for that as well!

This is such a great moisturizer without being too thick or overly greasy. My skin feels smoother and looks more plump after a few usages. A little goes a long way which I really love for a value standpoint. The scent is not strong or noticeable. Perfect moisturizer for fine lines and dry skin!

This is a nice hydrating moisturizer. I like that the consistency isn't too heavy and blends out easily. There is a slight mint scent but it doesn't last long. I used this every night for a full month and while the change isn't huge there is definitely lessening of the appearance of wrinkles.

Strivectin has been around forever and is a tried and true brand. I was very excited to try this. I love that you can use it all over and that it targets wrinkles and stretch marks! No gross smell and it's very moisturizing! Packaging is basic and easy to use. If it ain't broke don't fix it! I'm excited to see the results in the coming months.

avis.titre: It might take a little longer
avis.texte: This is my first StriVectin product, so I didn't know what to expect much from it. To be fair, I was a little hesitant when I saw it was an intensive moisturizer because my skin is oily, but I was pleasantly surprised. It is a thicker moisturizer than the ones I have, but the benefits seem worth it. It is not as fast-absorbing as I am used to, but it also doesn't make my skin greasier. It smells of peppermint, which I like. I haven't seen any relevant results other than hydration yet, so I can't say much about skin texture or wrinkle reduction but it is a great product.

avis.titre: Great product, just need more time!
avis.texte: I loved getting the opportunity to use this StriVectin cream! It is a well-known and trusted brand that has the reputation of working! I was able to try it for a little over a month, the bottle is very sleek and easy to dispense the cream. The moisturizer itself is very lightweight has a nice clean scent and even a little bit of a tingle as you rub it into your skin. (Made me feel like the product was working!) Attached are a before and after photo…. I'm not thoroughly convinced, but I had the product long enough to see full results, but I enjoyed using it and felt like it was helping the appearance of static lines in my neck. I'm eager to continue using!

I've been using this twice a day the last month to keep my stretch marks at bay during my pregnancy and it's been helping a lot. I like that it absorbs quickly into the skin without irritation and it has a blend of peptides to help keep my skin hydrated and healthy.

First of all, I need to say that I loved this super hydrating and moisturizing product that doesn't leave my skin feeling oily or heavy. I used it for a few weeks and loved the results; my skin felt softer and silkier. The packaging is practical and the product is scent-free, which is great for sensitive skin like mine.

avis.titre: Easy to use for instant smoothness
avis.texte: StriVectin SD Advanced Plus intensive moisturizer is thick and creamy, puts off a fresh minty scent, and feels luxurious on the skin. It comes in a convenient squeeze tube that is easy to open and close. Full of collagen boosting peptides, this cream instantly makes wrinkles and stretch marks appear smoother. It's too early for me to tell any distinct results on this old momma tummy, but it's definitely smoother and softer.

I used the SD Advanced Plus Intensive Moisturizer every morning and night for the past four weeks. I noticed that my forehead lines were definitely softened. The moisturizer absorbed quickly and wasn't heavy at all for an intensive moisturizer. I would definitely consider purchasing as we head into the drier time of year.

I received this moisturizer complimentary from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. ​It's a little hard to fully evaluate this product since I received it during the summer. I often skip moisturizer in favor of a lighter SPF when it's hot, and this one feels pretty heavy. It's more like a body butter than a typical face cream, and it can leave a slightly filmy feeling on the skin. I haven't tried it under makeup yet. ​As for its moisturizing abilities, it definitely leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth. However, I'm skeptical about its claims to reduce wrinkles. I believe you'd need to use it for an extended period, maybe an entire bottle or more, to see any real difference. Personally, I'm not convinced that a topical cream can do much for wrinkles, but this product does a great job of keeping my skin hydrated and preventing that dry feeling. ​Given how many moisturizers are on the market, I'm not sure if I'd purchase this one again.

Good product. Nice texture. Mild scent. Good size packaging. Beneficial ingredients. It does make a bit of difference, makes my skin feel a bit more smooth and helps smooth some light wrinkles. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]
It's a simply bottle. The effectiveness is so so. I haven't noticed a difference on stretch marks so far but I do notice it's highly hydrating. May need more time. It's absorbed quickly into the skin

I really like this product. It feels extra hydrating on my skin. You don't need too much. The product little bit goes a long way with this product. I put it on at night and I wake up, feeling very moisturized and my skin definitely reflects that.

avis.titre: Okay moisturizer, not much physical difference
avis.texte: I had really high hopes for this Strivectin SD Advanced Plus Intensive Moisturizer, as I had long heard that Strivectin has shown people really great results. Unfortunately, I haven't really been able to see any real difference in my fine lines/stretch marks after using this twice daily. I wasn't expecting a miracle, but I can't say I've seen any improvement at all. As a regular moisturizer, it's fine, though it has a slightly greasy feel to it that doesn't sink in for a couple of hours. It is also completely unscented which I know a lot of people may appreciate. Overall, it feels like a fairly hydrating moisturizer, but unfortunately I did not see any difference, even in fine lines.

I used this product twice daily on my face and neck. I have normal for my age lines on my face, but my neck has recently started showing some heavy lines. After using this product for about a month, I have noticed a significant change in the texture of the skin on my neck. It's also seemed to smooth out the heavy lines so they aren't as noticeable. The cream blends in easily and does not leave a greasy residue. I was able to wear sunblock and makeup over it during the day without it feeling cakey. Even though the cream is thick, it doesn't feel heavy on the skin and has a mild minty scent that I loved. Overall, I felt this product is definitely worth it for smoothing texture and minimizing lines. I highly recommend for women over 50 with hormonal changes to skin texture.

I'm eager to continue using this as a permanent fixture of my skin care routine!

The moisturizer is a good consistency and it's easy to use. It is non scented which is nice. I haven't seen a lot of results but it has only been 30 days. I like that it is morning or night use and flexible.

SD Advanced Plus Intensive moisturizer. Nice thick daily moisturizer. Absorbs quickly and keeps my skin bright and moisturized all day. I can't say I noticed a huge difference in my wrinkles, but consistency takes time. Smells like a spa.

I was really happy to receive this because I'd been looking for a new moisturizer, and this one is noncomegenogenic. A little bit goes a long way, and it glides smoothly. It's not greasy, and it's great for a base under makeup.
